opening_message:
Ticket 1: Donna Ball (employee ID E024) requests write access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E024.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: contractor
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Donna Ball is a contractor (Payroll Specialist). Per policy, contractors may have read, or write only with advanced security training (never admin). HR has no training record; recommend read unless Security confirms advanced training, which would allow write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security record confirms Donna Ball is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training. Basic training caps her at read, despite requested write. Recommend read for Source Code.
reason: Donna Ball is a contractor with basic security training (Security record). Per policy, contractors may have read, or write only with advanced security training; basic training caps her at read. Her requested write exceeds the maximum, so the maximum (read) is granted.

Employee: Donna Ball (E024)

- Donna has basic training, not advanced. So her maximum is read.

Requested level: write. Maximum: read. Since requested is above maximum, grant maximum = read.

Decision: read.
